# JUDO Tatami Base

> Model transformation pipeline for the JUDO platform, converting Platform-Specific Models (PSM) through automated steps into application models, database schemas, migration scripts, expression models, and identity provider configurations.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ multi-module project with 10 submodules
- Transformation engine: Eclipse Epsilon (ETL/EOL/EGL/EVL scripts)
- Model framework: Eclipse EMF (Ecore metamodels, EObjects)
- Module system: OSGi bundles (Apache Felix Maven Bundle Plugin)
- Supports three database dialects: HSQLDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle
- Full source-to-target traceability via TransformationTrace objects
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, transformation pipeline diagram, module descriptions, and build instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Detailed developer guide with build commands, directory structure, technology stack, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, issue reporting, and pull request guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Branching strategy and CI/CD workflow documentation

## Modules — Transformations

- [judo-tatami-psm2asm/pom.xml](judo-tatami-psm2asm/pom.xml): PSM to ASM (Architecture Specific Model) transformation using Epsilon ETL
- [judo-tatami-psm2measure/pom.xml](judo-tatami-psm2measure/pom.xml): PSM to Measure transformation — extracts measurement unit definitions
- [judo-tatami-asm2rdbms/pom.xml](judo-tatami-asm2rdbms/pom.xml): ASM to RDBMS transformation with HSQLDB, PostgreSQL, and Oracle dialect support
- [judo-tatami-asm2expression/pom.xml](judo-tatami-asm2expression/pom.xml): ASM to Expression transformation — builds expression trees from JQL queries (Java-based, not Epsilon)
- [judo-tatami-asm2keycloak/pom.xml](judo-tatami-asm2keycloak/pom.xml): ASM to Keycloak transformation — generates identity and authorization model
- [judo-tatami-rdbms2liquibase/pom.xml](judo-tatami-rdbms2liquibase/pom.xml): RDBMS to Liquibase transformation — generates full and incremental database migration changesets

## Modules — Validation

- [judo-tatami-psm-validation/pom.xml](judo-tatami-psm-validation/pom.xml): PSM (Platform Specific Model) model constraint validation using Epsilon EVL
- [judo-tatami-asm-validation/pom.xml](judo-tatami-asm-validation/pom.xml): ASM (Architecture Specific Model) model constraint validation using Epsilon EVL
- [judo-tatami-expression-asm-validation/pom.xml](judo-tatami-expression-asm-validation/pom.xml): Validates expression models against ASM structure
- [judo-tatami-expression-psm-validation/pom.xml](judo-tatami-expression-psm-validation/pom.xml): Validates expression models against PSM structure

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-asm](../../models/judo-meta-asm): ASM metamodel — Ecore-based architecture model with builders and validation
- [judo-meta-expression](../../models/judo-meta-expression): Expression metamodel — type-safe numeric, string, temporal, and collection expressions
- [judo-meta-expression-asm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-asm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ASM for symbolic reference resolution
- [judo-meta-expression-psm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-psm): Bridges Expression metamodel with PSM for type resolution and measurement support
- [judo-meta-jql](../../models/judo-meta-jql): JQL metamodel — Xtext-based declarative query language
- [judo-meta-keycloak](../../models/judo-meta-keycloak): Keycloak IAM configuration metamodel
- [judo-meta-liquibase](../../models/judo-meta-liquibase): Liquibase database change management metamodel
- [judo-meta-measure](../../models/judo-meta-measure): SI units metamodel — measures, units, and conversion rates
- [judo-meta-psm](../../models/judo-meta-psm): PSM metamodel — foundational platform-specific data model
- [judo-meta-rdbms](../../models/judo-meta-rdbms): RDBMS schema metamodel with incremental evolution tracking
- [osgi-repackaged-bundles](../../packages/osgi-repackaged-bundles): Third-party libraries repackaged as OSGi bundles for Karaf
- [judo-dao-api](../judo-dao-api): Core DAO interfaces for CRUD, query, navigation, and validation
- [judo-dispatcher-api](../judo-dispatcher-api): Dispatcher API contracts for routing API calls to runtime actions
- [judo-operation-utils](../judo-operation-utils): Base classes and collection operations for generated operation scripts
- [judo-sdk-common](../judo-sdk-common): Base classes for generated SDK — entity identity, DAO base, and query filters
- [judo-tatami](../judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-core](../judo-tatami-core): EMF transformation trace tracking and composable workflow engine
- [judo-tatami-util](../judo-tatami-util): Utility facade for EMF model transformation traces
- [epsilon-runtime](../../tools/epsilon-runtime): Eclipse Epsilon runtime for Maven and OSGi environments
- [java-embedded-compiler](../../tools/java-embedded-compiler): Runtime Java compilation with JDK javac and Eclipse ECJ backends

## Used by

- [judo-platform](../judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-rdbms-schema](../judo-rdbms-schema): Incremental database schema migration via RDBMS model comparison
- [judo-runtime-core](../judo-runtime-core): Multi-module runtime engine — data access, business logic, REST, and security
- [judo-runtime-core-esm-itest](../judo-runtime-core-esm-itest): Integration tests for ESM-to-RDBMS transformation pipeline
- [judo-runtime-core-jsl](../judo-runtime-core-jsl): JSL support for runtime core — model parsing through to DAOs and schema
- [judo-services](../judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [judo-tatami-jsl](../judo-tatami-jsl): JSL-to-runtime model transformation engine (PSM, ASM, UI, RDBMS, etc.)
- [judo-jsl-springboot-parent](../../spring/judo-jsl-springboot-parent): Parent POM for JUDO JSL Spring Boot applications
- [judo-jsl-springboot-starter](../../spring/judo-jsl-springboot-starter): Spring Boot starter aggregating the entire JUDO runtime stack
